text.en:
The sum of two thousand two hundred and fifty pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary,
is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the completion
of barracks and quarters for the Philippine Constabulary at Cabugao, Apayao, Mountain Province.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 16, 1916.
